title: hemionitis dilimanensis
intro: Hemionitis dilimanensis, commonly known as the Diliman Shield Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hemionitis dilimanensis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
